evals.prompt: We have 20 Dependabot PRs piled up. Sweep them and merge the safe ones.
evals.expected_output: Enumerates bot PRs, classifies HOLD first then REVIEW then AUTO-MERGE, confirms, then merges only the safe bucket.
assertions: Resolves the target branch from release-cadence-config.json (release_branch if release-train, else main)
Enumerates open PRs by dependabot, renovate and pre-commit-ci authors
Evaluates HOLD conditions before REVIEW before AUTO-MERGE
Security advisories, major bumps, failing CI and always_hold packages are HOLD and never auto-merged
Only devDependency, patch-with-green-CI, lockfile-only and pre-commit bumps are auto-merge candidates
Confirms with the user before merging the auto-merge bucket

evals.prompt: There is a patch bump of lodash with green CI, but it is flagged as a security advisory. Handle the dependabot queue.
assertions: Classifies the advisory PR as HOLD despite patch size and green CI
Comments on the PR with the reason and leaves it open
Skips the changelog batch phase in release-please repos

evals.prompt: Review the PR my teammate opened that refactors the billing module.
evals.expected_output: A human-authored feature PR, not a bot dependency queue.
assertions: Does not classify or merge bot PRs
